The supported CLI subcommands and their flags are:

#### `agents-js acp`

| Flag | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--acp-args-json <json>` | value | JSON array of custom ACP args (only valid with --acp-command). |
| `--acp-command <command>` | value | Custom ACP command (requires --harness custom or no --harness; mutually exclusive with curated). |
| `--default-model <id>` | value | Default model id (AJS_DEFAULT_MODEL override). |
| `--directory <path>` | value | Constrain runtime to this workspace directory. |
| `--harness <id|custom>` | value | Select a curated harness or enter custom mode. |
| `--help` | flag | Show this message. |
| `--opencode-disable-external-plugins` | flag | Append --pure when launching opencode. |
| `--profile <name>` | value | Optional named profile for curated runtimes (not supported with --harness custom). |
| `--runtime-log-level <level>` | value | Runtime log level (debug\|info\|warn\|error\|silent). |
| `-h` | flag | Show this message. |

#### `agents-js bridge`

| Flag | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--default-model <id>` | value | Default model id (AJS_DEFAULT_MODEL override). |
| `--harness <id|custom>` | value | Select a curated harness or enter custom mode. |
| `--help` | flag | Show this message. |
| `--host <host>` | value | Bind host for the A2A server (default: 127.0.0.1). |
| `--opencode-disable-external-plugins` | flag | Append --pure when launching opencode. |
| `--port <port>` | value | Bind port (0 = auto-allocate). |
| `--runtime-log-level <level>` | value | Runtime log level (debug\|info\|warn\|error\|silent). |
| `-h` | flag | Show this message. |

#### `agents-js serve`

| Flag | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--acp-args-json <json>` | value | JSON array of custom ACP args (only valid with --acp-command). |
| `--acp-command <command>` | value | Custom ACP command (requires --harness custom or no --harness; mutually exclusive with curated). |
| `--default-model <id>` | value | Default model id (AJS_DEFAULT_MODEL override). |
| `--harness <id|custom>` | value | Select a curated harness or enter custom mode. Repeatable: pass --harness multiple times to declare the harness fleet in argv order (first = primary). Currently only the primary is resolved; secondary harnesses are accepted by the parser but not yet routed. |
| `--harnesses <id1,id2,...>` | value | Comma-separated list of curated harnesses (first = primary). Equivalent to repeating --harness. Currently only the primary is resolved; secondary harnesses are accepted by the parser but not yet routed. |
| `--help` | flag | Show this message. |
| `--host <host>` | value | Bind host for the A2A server (default: 127.0.0.1). |
| `--opencode-disable-external-plugins` | flag | Append --pure when launching opencode. |
| `--port <port>` | value | Bind port (0 = auto-allocate). |
| `--profile <name>` | value | Optional named profile for curated runtimes (not supported with --harness custom). |
| `--registry-sync` | flag | Enable cross-gateway peer registry sync (default: off; A2A-only payload). |
| `--runtime-log-level <level>` | value | Runtime log level (debug\|info\|warn\|error\|silent). |
| `-h` | flag | Show this message. |

#### `agents-js send`

| Flag | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--harness <id>` | value | Route to the first registered agent whose harness id matches. A miss is a hard error. Always threaded as metadata.harness on the outbound message. |
| `--help` | flag | Show this message. |
| `--raw` | flag | Stream message.delta chunks to stdout as they arrive. |
| `--url <base-url>` | value | Target serve base URL. Overrides --harness routing. Falls back to AGENTS_JS_SERVE_URL when neither is set. |
| `-h` | flag | Show this message. |
